candidate.title: TC-Seq
candidate.scope: The TC-Seq (translocation-capture sequencing) row of the assigned Illumina poster, interpreted as the engineered I-SceI bait-locus implementation in primary B cells described by Klein et al. The drawing retains +AID and −AID arms and illustrates a rearranged molecule surviving versus a native locus being cleaved. These are representative molecular fates, not an exhaustive partition of the two sample populations: the primary paper also captures rearrangements without AID. Neighboring TN-Seq/INSeq, Ig-seq/Rep-Seq/MAF, partial RC-Seq and chemical drawings are outside this card. No unshown library-preparation substeps or application workflows are reconstructed.
